mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO job ( job_name, company_name, company_logo, industry, company_size, company_funding, job_type, work_city, work_address, salary_min, salary_max, salary_type, salary_details, education_requirement, experience_requirement, work_days_per_week, work_duration_months, job_duty, job_requirement, raw_data, job_tags, special_tags, benefits, apply_link, source, publish_time, expire_time, status, is_urgent, view_count, collect_count ) VALUES
( #{job.jobName}, #{job.companyName}, #{job.companyLogo}, #{job.industry}, #{job.companySize}, #{job.companyFunding}, #{job.jobType}, #{job.workCity}, #{job.workAddress}, #{job.salaryMin}, #{job.salaryMax}, #{job.salaryType}, #{job.salaryDetails}, #{job.educationRequirement}, #{job.experienceRequirement}, #{job.workDaysPerWeek}, #{job.workDurationMonths}, #{job.jobDuty}, #{job.jobRequirement}, #{job.rawData}, #{job.jobTags}, #{job.specialTags}, #{job.benefits}, #{job.applyLink}, #{job.source}, #{job.publishTime}, #{job.expireTime}, #{job.status}, #{job.isUrgent}, #{job.viewCount}, #{job.collectCount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE job SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE job SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job WHERE id != #{jobId} AND status = 1 AND ( industry = #{industry} OR work_city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN industry = #{industry} AND work_city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN industry = #{industry} THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_collection jc INNER JOIN job j ON jc.job_id = j.id WHERE jc.user_id = #{userId} AND j.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_collection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_collection (user_id, job_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{jobId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM job_collection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND job_id = #{jobId}
